crew.overview: Deep in the forests of the Pacific Northwest, a father devoted to raising his six kids with a rigorous physical and intellectual education is forced to leave his paradise and enter the world, beginning a journey that challenges his idea of what it means to be a parent.
crew.title: Captain Fantastic

details.biography: Louise Runge is an Enflish film producer. She holds a Bachelor of Arts degree in American and Commonwealth Arts from the University of Exeter, and a Master of Arts degree in  Film and Television Production from the University of Bristol. From 2004 to 2006, she worked as a Post Production Manager for the Los Angeles-based Yari Film Group. From there, she was recruited by Upload FIlms where she post supervised nine films. In 2008, she co-founded with Samantha Housman an independent production company,  ONEZERO Films.
details.name: Louise Runge
